skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply statistical methods to analyze social and environmental issues.
Collect and select data for statistical analysis in social and environmental fields.
Use statistical software to build and evaluate models in social and environmental statistics.
Interpret statistical results and assess their economic and social implications.
Construct and calculate composite indices for complex social and environmental phenomena.
Develop critical thinking skills to address social and environmental issues.
Evaluate policies based on statistical analysis and provide decision support.
Conduct research on social and environmental issues using statistical tools.
